title: QIAGEN Allprep Mini RNA Extraction with RNase-Free DNase Set
author: vggh
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.n62dhge

steps.title: Homogenize Sample
steps.instruction: Homogenize the sample in up to 1ml of RLT buffer(+β-ME) using a Polytron large probe at 20K rpm, avoiding foaming.

substeps.instruction: Break every 15 seconds to allow the probe to cool off.
For non-muscle tissue: perform 2 repeats.
For muscle tissue: perform 3 homogenization rounds or until homogeneous.

steps.title: Separate Lysate and DNA Column Loading
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the lysate for 3 minutes at full speed (RT).

substeps.instruction: Transfer up to 600ul of the supernatant (avoiding pelleted cell debris) into an Allprep DNA mini spin column.
Centrifuge the DNA spin column for 30 sec at 10,000 rpm.
Repeat until all supernatant has passed through the DNA column, ensuring the flow-through (containing RNA) is kept.

steps.title: Store DNA Column
steps.instruction: Place the Allprep DNA spin column in a new 2ml collection tube and store at 4°C for later DNA purification.

steps.title: Prepare RNA Sample
steps.instruction: Add 713 μl of 100% ethanol to the flow-through (adjust volume based on starting RLT volume) and mix well by pipetting or vortexing all tubes at once.

steps.title: Load RNeasy Column
steps.instruction: Transfer up to 600 μl of the sample to the RNeasy mini spin column.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge for 15 sec at 10,000 rpm.
Discard the flow-through.
Repeat until all lysate+ethanol has passed through the column.

steps.title: First RNA Wash
steps.instruction: Add 350 μl Buffer RW1 to the RNeasy spin column and centrifuge for 15 sec at 10,000 rpm.

substeps.instruction: Discard the flow-through.

steps.title: DNase Treatment
steps.instruction: Prepare DNase master mix and treat the RNeasy spin column membrane.

substeps.instruction: Combine 10ul DNase with 70ul RDD buffer per sample to prepare the master mix.
Add 80 μl of DNase master mix to each RNeasy spin column membrane.
Incubate on the bench top for at least 30 min, but no longer than 1 hour.

steps.title: Second RNA Wash
steps.instruction: Add 350 μl Buffer RW1 to the RNeasy spin column and centrifuge for 15 sec at 10,000 rpm.

substeps.instruction: Discard the flow-through.

steps.title: RPE Wash Sequence
steps.instruction: Wash the RNeasy spin column membrane using Buffer RPE.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 μl Buffer RPE, centrifuge for 15 sec at 10,000 rpm, and discard flow-through. Repeat this step.
Add 500 μl Buffer RPE, centrifuge for 2 min at 10,000 rpm, and discard flow-through.
Place the RNeasy spin column in a new 2 ml collection tube.
Centrifuge at full speed for 1 min.

steps.title: Elute RNA
steps.instruction: Elute RNA into a new 1.5 ml collection tube.

substeps.instruction: Add 50 μl RNase-free water directly to the spin column membrane.
Incubate at RT for 2 minutes.
Centrifuge for 1 min at 10,000 rpm to elute RNA.
Perform a second elution with 30 μl RNase-free water to ensure complete yield.
Quantify concentration using Qubit RNA BR (target total amount for sequencing is 2ug).
Measure RNA quality using Bioanalyzer Nanochip or Picochip (target RIN > 7 for uncompromised mammalian tissues).

steps.title: Final Preparation
steps.instruction: Perform ERCC spike in addition for sequencing designated aliquote.
